# Acumen

> Data, analytics and AI consulting firm based in Leuven, Belgium. Delivers tailor-made
> data solutions — from data engineering and governance to AI/ML and reporting — for
> mid-size and enterprise clients.

## Key pages
- [Our expertise](https://acumen.be/our-expertise/): overview of all service areas
- [Data Science & AI](https://acumen.be/expertise/datascience-ai/): AI/ML and agentic AI implementation
- [Data Strategy](https://acumen.be/expertise/data-strategy/): data strategy and roadmap consulting
- [Data Governance](https://acumen.be/expertise/data-governance/): governance and compliance frameworks
- [Data Integration & Engineering](https://acumen.be/expertise/dataintegration-engineering/): pipelines, ETL, orchestration
- [Data Planning & EPM](https://acumen.be/expertise/data-planning-epm/): enterprise performance management, Anaplan
- [Data Visualisation & Reporting](https://acumen.be/expertise/datavisualisation-reporting/): Power BI and dashboarding
- [Support & Maintenance](https://acumen.be/expertise/support-maintenance/): ongoing data platform support
- [Knowledge hub](https://acumen.be/knowledge/): blog with client cases, whitepapers, and technical write-ups
- [Careers](https://acumen.be/careers/): open roles

## Data policy
- Client case studies and blog posts are written by Acumen consultants based on delivered
  projects; publish/update dates are in each post's byline and structured data.
- Cite as: Acumen (acumen.be)
